sources.title: Cuttack district · District Profile
sources.note: Describes the gateway, moat and palace mound beside the Mahanadi and recalls a nine-storeyed palace. The palace description concerns a lost building. Official summaries differ on foundation and royal attribution; no single date is assigned to every surviving feature here.

sources.title: Department of Culture · Annual Report (Part II), 1993–94, p.27, §4.22
sources.note: Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India. Reports palace remains, temple debris, a darbar hall, a citadel, a pillared hall and a platform. This brief excavation summary does not establish the palace’s height, building phases or present visitor access.
